debt: 6 cell(s) where two debt lines are the same filed fact (same value, date and filing under two tags) are counted once — e.g. 2016-06-30 long_term_debt (LongTermDebtNoncurrent) = short_term_debt (ShortTermBorrowings) = 250,000,000; the short_term_debt cell is blank

interest expense: the row mixes gross and NET figures, so it keeps the label "Interest expense"; net (income inside) for 2 period(s) 2025-06-30..2026-06-30 — including 1 filed under the gross tag whose value equals minus the filer's net interest tag for that period

quarters not derived (the year-to-date fact's tag has no shorter leg in the same tag: the 10-Qs carried the figure in another caption; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_opex 2019-12-31, other_opex 2022-12-31, operating_income 2008-12-31, operating_income 2009-12-31, operating_income 2016-12-31, operating_income 2017-12-31, operating_income 2018-12-31, interest_expense 2008-12-31, interest_expense 2009-12-31, interest_expense 2010-12-31, interest_expense 2011-12-31, interest_expense 2012-12-31...

catch-all cash-flow quarters blanked (the two legs' filings present the section differently, so their difference is no filed figure; flagged basis_break_quarterly): other_investing 2023-12-31 (2,571,000 - -6,785,000; the longer leg's filing adds acquisitions)

restricted cash: in 24 period(s), 2019-12-31..2026-06-30 the cash line is the filed cash + restricted cash total (CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents, the cash-flow statement's total, read where the annual report filed no CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for the date); in 1 period, 2019-12-31 it holds no restricted cash (the same date's CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue equals the total, or the restricted-cash figure is 0): nothing deducted, not marked; in 23 period(s), 2020-12-31..2026-06-30 no figure separates the restricted part, so where those metrics are computed they still count restricted cash as cash (net cash overstated, net debt understated by the restricted amount; flagged incl_restricted_* and labelled 'some periods incl. restricted cash' on the metric; growth across a change between the two bases is blank)

free cash flow: 6 period(s) (2018-12-31..2020-12-31) report discontinued operations' investing cash flows on their own line, so capex is continuing-only there — FCF and owner's earnings use continuing OCF (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations, else OCF − CashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesDiscontinuedOperations from the same filing), blank where neither is filed; the OCF line itself stays the filed total
net margin: continuing net income ÷ revenue for 8 period(s) with discontinued operations (2018-12-31..2020-12-31) — revenue is continuing-only there

same filing: 2 fiscal-year cell(s) of a derived figure are blank because its inputs' values come from different filing generations (one restated by a later filing, the other as originally filed) although one filing reports them all: ebitda 2018-12-31, operating_margin 2018-12-31

growth across filing generations: 57 annual growth cell(s) are blank because the year and the year before come from different filings that disagree (one restated by a later filing — discontinued operations, an accounting change, a recast — the other as originally filed; or a capex caption change): accounts_payable (2019-12-31); acquisitions (2011-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31); book_value_per_share (2011-12-31); capex (2018-12-31); change_inventory (2018-12-31); change_payables (2018-12-31); change_receivables (2008-12-31, 2018-12-31); change_working_capital (2008-12-31); cost_of_revenue (2018-12-31); current_lt_debt (2024-12-31); da (2018-12-31); deferred_tax_assets (2011-12-31, 2019-12-31); ...
